description: Aarberg’s old town opens onto a wide Stadtplatz, and the covered wooden bridge of 1566–69 crosses the Alte Aare on three stone piers. The bridge is about 86 metres long, with hanging trusses under a slightly hipped roof. The main Aare was diverted by the Hagneck canal, so the frame is the old channel and the arcaded square, not a river island in flood. The Open-Meteo model is heavily clouded and warm, with no rain.
